Angel Reese has cleared 8+ rebounds in 91% of her 45 games this season, and is riding a 17-game streak of doing it. She's hitting 100% over her last 10 and 100% over her last 5, averaging 11.8 rebounds on the season (11.4 across her last 5) — the 8+ line sits well below her normal output. Priced -625 at BetRivers.

Dominique Malonga has cleared 10+ points in 81% of her 37 games this season. She's hitting 80% over her last 10 and 80% over her last 5, averaging 16.3 points on the season (15.6 across her last 5) — the 10+ line sits well below her normal output. Priced -572 at DraftKings.

Two legs from two different games at a combined -276 — each leg stands on its own record, and neither result can drag the other down.
